returnFields.name: Company
returnFields.typeDefinitions:
type Company {
  id: ID!
  name: String!
  note: String
  externalId: String
  customerSince: String
  createdAt: String!
  updatedAt: String!
  "What changed in this update, with the old and new value of each field. Empty when nothing the trigger reports changed or the record had no stored values yet"
  changes: ResourceChanges
}

"One field that changed in this update"
type FieldChange {
  "The field that changed: name, note, externalId or customerSince"
  field: String!
  "The value before the update. Long values are shortened"
  oldValue: String
  "The value after the update. Long values are shortened"
  newValue: String
}

"Old and new values of the fields that changed"
type ResourceChanges {
  "Names of the fields that changed"
  fields: [String!]!
  "Old and new value per changed field"
  items: [FieldChange!]!
  "True when the update changed more than one event carries: items then holds the first changes only, while fields still names every field that changed"
  truncated: Boolean
  "How many changes the update had, including any not in items"
  totalCount: Int
}

# A `Changed<Entity>` block names the object when Flow offers no native reference for it. Flow's commerce references
# are order, product, customer, company and company contact only: a `<entity>_reference` for collection, draft order,
# location, market, page, blog or blog post fails the deploy with "key property must be specified for non-commerce
# object fields" (probed 2026-06-24); product variant and company location ride their parent's reference plus this
# block. Its fields are immutable identifiers a Merchant recognizes; editable labels (title, handle) stay out.

type ChangedProductVariant {

# Rejected payload keys: `specificationHandle`, `accountName` and `accountId` read null on first-party channels
# (verified live, 2026-07); `Publication.name` is deprecated.
"A sales channel a product or collection was published to or unpublished from."
type SalesChannel {
  "The publication GID of the sales channel."
  id: ID!
  "The sales channel's Channel GID."
  channelId: ID
  "The name of the sales channel (e.g. Online Store)."
  name: String
  "A human-readable channel identifier (e.g. online_store, pos); may carry an account-id suffix."
  handle: String
  "The GID of the app backing the sales channel — a stable key; use it to look up app details if needed."
  appId: ID
}

"A market (region) a product was published to or unpublished from."
type Market {
  "The publication GID of the market."
  id: ID!
  "The MarketCatalog GID backing the market."
  catalogId: ID
  "The market (catalog) name (e.g. Mexico)."
  name: String
}

"A line item that was added to or removed from an order."
type OrderLineItemSummary {
  "The line item GID (e.g. gid://shopify/LineItem/42). It stays the same across edits and refunds, so a workflow can match a line it saw before."
  id: ID!
  "The product variant GID (e.g. gid://shopify/ProductVariant/42). Empty for a custom line, or when the variant no longer exists."
  variantId: ID
  "The product GID (e.g. gid://shopify/Product/7). Empty for a custom line, or when the product no longer exists."
  productId: ID
  "Whether the line is a custom one, with no product variant backing it."
  custom: Boolean!
  "The product or variant title. Can be empty for a line that was removed."
  title: String
  "The SKU of the line. Empty for a custom line, or when the variant has no SKU."
  sku: String
  "The number of units on the line."
  quantity: Int!
  "The line total in the store's currency, after the line's own discount."
  amount: Float!
}

"A whole-number value before and after the change, and the difference between them."
type LineItemQuantityChange {
  "Value before the change."
  previous: Int!
  "Value after the change."
  current: Int!
  "Current minus previous. Negative when the value went down."
  delta: Int!
}

"A money value before and after the change, and the difference between them, in the store's currency."
type LineItemMoneyChange {
  "Value before the change."
  previous: Float!
  "Value after the change."
  current: Float!
  "Current minus previous. Negative when the value went down."
  delta: Float!
}

"A line item that stayed on the order, with the values that changed."
type OrderLineItemChange {
  "The line item GID (e.g. gid://shopify/LineItem/42). It stays the same across edits and refunds, so a workflow can match a line it saw before."
  id: ID!
  "The product variant GID (e.g. gid://shopify/ProductVariant/42). Empty for a custom line, or when the variant no longer exists."
  variantId: ID
  "The product GID (e.g. gid://shopify/Product/7). Empty for a custom line, or when the product no longer exists."
  productId: ID
  "Whether the line is a custom one, with no product variant backing it."
  custom: Boolean!
  "The product or variant title."
  title: String
  "The SKU of the line. Empty for a custom line, or when the variant has no SKU."
  sku: String
  "How the number of units changed."
  quantity: LineItemQuantityChange!
  "How the line total, after the line's own discount, changed."
  amount: LineItemMoneyChange!
  "How the line's own discount changed — the one already taken off the amount."
  discount: LineItemMoneyChange!
}

"What changed about an order's line items in a single edit or refund."
type OrderLineItemsChange {
  "Lines that were added."
  added: [OrderLineItemSummary!]!
  "Lines that were removed, with the quantity and amount they had before."
  removed: [OrderLineItemSummary!]!
  "Lines that stayed, with the values that changed."
  changed: [OrderLineItemChange!]!
  "How many lines were added in total. Always the full number, even when the lists were shortened."
  addedCount: Int!
  "How many lines were removed in total. Always the full number, even when the lists were shortened."
  removedCount: Int!
  "How many lines changed in total. Always the full number, even when the lists were shortened."
  changedCount: Int!
  "Whether the lists were shortened because the change was very large. The lists keep their first entries, and the counts above stay complete."
  truncated: Boolean!
}

"A line item that was added to or removed from a draft order. One entry covers all lines of that product variant together."
type DraftOrderLineItemSummary {
  "The product variant GID (e.g. gid://shopify/ProductVariant/42). Empty for a custom line, or when the variant no longer exists."
  variantId: ID
  "The product GID (e.g. gid://shopify/Product/7). Empty for a custom line, or when the product no longer exists."
  productId: ID
  "Whether the line is a custom one, with no product variant backing it."
  custom: Boolean!
  "The product or variant title. Can be empty for a line that was removed."
  title: String
  "The SKU of the line. Empty for a custom line, or when the variant has no SKU."
  sku: String
  "The number of units, across all lines of that product variant."
  quantity: Int!
  "The line total in the store's currency, after the line's own discount, across all lines of that product variant. It is not a per-unit price."
  amount: Float!
}

"A line item that stayed on the draft order, with the values that changed. The values cover all lines of that product variant together."
type DraftOrderLineItemChange {
  "The product variant GID (e.g. gid://shopify/ProductVariant/42). Empty for a custom line, or when the variant no longer exists."
  variantId: ID
  "The product GID (e.g. gid://shopify/Product/7). Empty for a custom line, or when the product no longer exists."
  productId: ID
  "Whether the line is a custom one, with no product variant backing it."
  custom: Boolean!
  "The product or variant title."
  title: String
  "The SKU of the line. Empty for a custom line, or when the variant has no SKU."
  sku: String
  "How the number of units changed, across all lines of that product variant."
  quantity: LineItemQuantityChange!
  "How the line total, after the line's own discount, changed across all lines of that product variant. It is not a per-unit price."
  amount: LineItemMoneyChange!
  "How the line's own discount changed — the one already taken off the amount."
  discount: LineItemMoneyChange!
}

"What changed about a draft order's line items in a single save."
type DraftOrderLineItemsChange {
  "Entries that were added."
  added: [DraftOrderLineItemSummary!]!
  "Entries that were removed, with the quantity and amount they had before."
  removed: [DraftOrderLineItemSummary!]!
  "Entries that stayed, with the values that changed."
  changed: [DraftOrderLineItemChange!]!
  "How many entries were added in total. Always the full number, even when the lists were shortened."
  addedCount: Int!
  "How many entries were removed in total. Always the full number, even when the lists were shortened."
  removedCount: Int!
  "How many entries changed in total. Always the full number, even when the lists were shortened."
  changedCount: Int!
  "Whether the lists were shortened because the change was very large. The lists keep their first entries, and the counts above stay complete."
  truncated: Boolean!
}

"A single value of a product option, as it appears in the option's value list."
type ProductOptionChangeValue {
  "A globally-unique ID."
  id: ID!
  "The name of the product option value."
  name: String!
  "The value of the linked metafield."
  linkedValue: ID
}

"The metafield identifier a product option is linked to."
type LinkedMetafield {
  "Key of the metafield the option is linked to."
  key: String
  "Namespace of the metafield the option is linked to."
  namespace: String
}

# Runs arrive in any order (rate limits, HTTP races), so `current` is the option as the app saw it when the run was
# queued, and a condition on which value comes first reads the live product. Hence no `firstValue` on this block.
"What changed about one product option: its values before and after, and what was added or removed. One option, one run."
type ProductOptionChange {
  "A globally-unique ID."
  id: ID!
  "The product option's name."
  name: String!
  "The product option's position."
  position: Int!
  "The metafield identifier linked to this option."
  linkedMetafield: LinkedMetafield
  "The values after the change, in their current order. Empty when the whole option was removed."
  current: [ProductOptionChangeValue!]!
  "The values before the change, in their previous order. Empty when the option — or the whole product — is new to the app."
  previous: [ProductOptionChangeValue!]!
  "Values that were added. Renaming a value on a regular option reports the new name here, and the old one under removed. Empty when the values were only reordered."
  added: [ProductOptionChangeValue!]!
  "Values that were removed. Renaming a value on a regular option reports the old name here, and the new one under added. Empty when the values were only reordered."
  removed: [ProductOptionChangeValue!]!
}
